Introduction

MYTRO is a South Korean pre-debut trot boy group formed in collaboration between SM Entertainment and TV Chosun. Comprising of five members—Tey, Jung Yoonjae, Shohei, Chaepyoung, and Seo Woohyeok—MYTRO is set to embark on their journey as a trot idol group. Their television program will air in Korea and Japan in October 2024.

Fans suddenly noticed that the group's SNS accounts had all been deactivated as of May 9, 2025. With no statement being made by SM or Yamyam Entertainment, the group's future is uncertain.
